# Scott Steele — The Steele Advantage

> Scott Steele is a licensed real estate agent and CEO/Operating Principal at The Ponte Group, Keller Williams South Watuppa, serving SE Massachusetts and Rhode Island.

## Who Scott Is

Scott Steele is a KW Luxury International certified REALTOR® licensed in both Massachusetts and Rhode Island. He leads The Ponte Group Luxury Division and personally serves buyers and sellers across 20+ markets in Bristol County MA, Plymouth County MA, and Providence and Bristol County RI.

He is a Zillow Flex certified partner and serves as the team's Director of Operations — overseeing agent recruiting, CRM architecture (Follow Up Boss), and training systems.

## Track Record

- 160+ personal closed transactions
- $55M+ in closed volume
- 102% list-to-sale ratio
- 14-day average days on market
- 2-hour response guarantee

## Specialties

- Luxury residential ($1M+)
- Waterfront and coastal properties
- REO, estate, and probate transactions
- Buyer and seller representation
- Agent recruiting and team operations

## Markets Served

Fall River MA, Dartmouth MA, Westport MA, New Bedford MA, Taunton MA, Attleboro MA, Mansfield MA, Swansea MA, Bristol RI, Tiverton RI, Warren RI, Barrington RI, Portsmouth RI, Little Compton RI, and surrounding communities.
